title: Build PoolsPage with pool list, stats, and drill-down
description:
PoolsPage.tsx is a stub (`
Worker Pools
`). Build a full pool management page. **Implementation:** - Use `useWorkers()` hook to group workers by pool - Render pool cards in a responsive grid showing: pool name, worker count (by status), total capacity vs active jobs, utilization % (color-coded bar), health indicator - Click pool card to expand/drill into worker list for that pool - Sort pools by utilization (highest first) - Add filter by health status (healthy/degraded/critical) **Patterns:** Follow PoolUtilizationGrid (components/home/) but with more detail and interactivity. Use Card, Badge, ProgressBar primitives. **Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/PoolsPage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: PoolsPage shows all pools with stats
Pool cards show worker count, capacity, utilization %

implementationPlan.description: Rewrite dashboard/src/pages/PoolsPage.tsx. Import useWorkers() hook. Group workers by pool using useMemo. For each pool compute: worker count (total, online, offline, draining), total capacity, active jobs, utilization % (activeJobs/capacity*100). Render responsive grid of pool cards (1/2/3 cols). Each card shows: pool name (h3), worker count badges by status, capacity bar (ProgressBar, color-coded: green <50%, yellow 50-80%, red >80%), active/capacity ratio text. Sort pools by utilization descending. Add health filter dropdown (All, Healthy <80%, Degraded 80-95%, Critical >95%). Loading skeleton, error state, empty state ('No worker pools detected').
implementationPlan.note: Full rewrite from stub. Groups workers by pool via useMemo, computes stats (online/offline/draining, capacity, utilization %, health tier). Responsive 1/2/3 col grid. Health filter (all/healthy/degraded/critical). Loading skeleton, error state, empty state. Sorted by utilization descending.

implementationPlan.description: Add drill-down: clicking a pool card expands it (or opens a section below) showing the worker list for that pool. Render a compact table: worker name, status badge, active/capacity, last heartbeat (relative time), uptime. Click worker row navigates to /agents with pool filter pre-applied. Use useState for selectedPool, toggle on click.
implementationPlan.note: Drill-down already included in step 1 implementation. Click pool card toggles expanded state (selectedPool useState). Expanded section shows worker table with: name + status dot, status badge, active/capacity, last heartbeat (relative time). Chevron icon toggles between right/down.
